livekit-client.umd.js
=====================

livekit-client.umd.js, next to this file, is livekit-client 2.22.3, LiveKit's client SDK for browsers
(https://github.com/livekit/client-sdk-js): the dist/livekit-client.umd.js file of its npm package, byte for byte.
The game's voice page (html/index.html) loads it.

livekit-client is Copyright 2021 LiveKit, Inc., licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. The licence's full
text is livekit-client.LICENSE.txt, next to this file.

That one file also has these packages built into it, each under its own licence, at the versions livekit-client
2.22.3 was built with. Their full licence texts follow below.

  Package             Version  Licence                       Copyright
  @livekit/protocol   1.50.4   Apache-2.0                    Copyright 2023 LiveKit, Inc.
  @livekit/mutex      1.1.1    Apache-2.0                    Copyright 2021 LiveKit, Inc.
  @bufbuild/protobuf  1.10.1   Apache-2.0 AND BSD-3-Clause   Copyright 2021-2024 Buf Technologies, Inc.;
                                                             its varint code: Copyright 2008 Google Inc.
  events              3.3.0    MIT                           Copyright Joyent, Inc. and other Node contributors
  jose                6.2.9    MIT                           Copyright (c) 2018 Filip Skokan
  loglevel            1.9.2    MIT                           Copyright (c) 2013 Tim Perry
  machina             7.0.1    MIT (also offered as GPL-2.0; Copyright (c) 2011-2023 Jim Cowart
                               used here under MIT)
  sdp-transform       2.15.0   MIT                           Copyright (c) 2013 Eirik Albrigtsen
  sdp                 3.2.2    MIT                           Copyright (c) 2017 Philipp Hancke
  webrtc-adapter      9.0.6    BSD-3-Clause                  Copyright (c) 2014, The WebRTC project authors;
                                                             Copyright (c) 2018, The adapter.js project authors
  tslib               2.8.1    0BSD                          Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation

And in livekit-client's own code, src/room/debounce.ts comes from ts-debounce (MIT, Copyright (c) 2017 Jakub
Chodorowicz).

The three Apache-2.0 parts (livekit-client, @livekit/protocol, @livekit/mutex) and the Apache-2.0 part of
@bufbuild/protobuf are under the same licence text: livekit-client.LICENSE.txt.

How this list was made: the packages are the ones the build's own source map (dist/livekit-client.umd.js.map)
names, at the versions it names, plus two it leaves out though the file holds them: @livekit/protocol (its
livekit.* messages; livekit-client 2.22.3 pins 1.50.4) and tslib (its helpers; pinned at 2.8.1). The texts below
are copied from each package's own files at that version: its licence file on npm or, for Google's and
ts-debounce's, the comment at the top of the file that carries them. LiveKit's NOTICE files are from its
repositories, as the npm packages leave them out. machina's licence file also has Backbone.js's licence, for code
this version no longer has, so it is not repeated here.
